points.title: 军事教育奠基
points.description: 东条英机出生于东京一个武士家庭，父亲东条英教是日本陆军少将。他在东京接受基础教育，后进入陆军幼年学校，开始了他的军事生涯。这一时期，日本正处于明治维新后快速军事化阶段，东条深受军国主义思想影响，形成了强烈的民族主义和扩张主义观念。他在陆军中央幼年学校和陆军士官学校接受了严格的军事训练，为日后在军界的崛起奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Tokyo to a samurai family, Hideki Tojo's father was a lieutenant general in the Japanese Army. He received his basic education in Tokyo before entering the Army Cadet School, beginning his military career. During this period, Japan was rapidly militarizing after the Meiji Restoration, and Tojo was deeply influenced by militaristic ideology, developing strong nationalist and expansionist views. He received rigorous military training at the Army Central Cadet School and Army War College, laying the foundation for his future rise in the military.

points.title: 关东军参谋
points.description: 1935年，东条英机被派往中国东北，担任关东军参谋。在这里，他积极参与了日本对中国东北的侵略活动，策划了多项军事行动。1936年，他成为关东军宪兵司令，强化了对东北地区的军事控制。这一时期，东条英机与日本军部的扩张主义政策紧密合作，为日本全面侵华战争做好了准备。他在关东军的经历使他积累了丰富的军事指挥经验，也加深了他对军国主义政策的认同。
points.descriptionEn: In 1935, Tojo was assigned to the Kwantung Army in Manchuria as a staff officer. Here, he actively participated in Japan's invasion of northeastern China, planning numerous military operations. In 1936, he became commander of the Kwantung Army's military police, strengthening military control over the region. During this period, Tojo closely cooperated with Japan's military expansionist policies, preparing for the full-scale invasion of China. His experience with the Kwantung Army provided him with extensive military command experience and deepened his commitment to militaristic policies.

points.title: 军部实权
points.description: 1940年，东条英机被任命为陆军大臣，成为日本军部的核心人物。在这一职位上，他积极推动日本与轴心国结盟，并强化国内军国主义统治。他主导通过了《总体战体制纲要》，将日本经济全面纳入战争轨道。1941年，他推动日本与德国、意大利签订三国同盟条约，进一步确立了日本在轴心国中的地位。作为陆军大臣，东条英机对日本国内政治的影响力日益增强，为日后成为首相铺平了道路。
points.descriptionEn: In 1940, Tojo was appointed Minister of War, becoming a central figure in Japan's military leadership. In this position, he actively promoted Japan's alliance with the Axis powers and strengthened domestic militaristic rule. He led the passage of the 'Total War System Outline,' integrating Japan's economy into a war footing. In 1941, he pushed for the Tripartite Pact with Germany and Italy, further solidifying Japan's position among the Axis powers. As Minister of War, Tojo's influence on Japanese domestic politics grew, paving the way for his future appointment as Prime Minister.

points.title: 战争首相
points.description: 1941年10月，东条英机出任日本首相，同时继续兼任陆军大臣，集军政大权于一身。他主导了珍珠港事件的决策，推动日本向美国、英国宣战，将太平洋战争推向高潮。在他的领导下，日本军队在亚洲和太平洋地区发动了一系列军事行动，占领了东南亚大片领土。东条英机实施高压统治，压制国内反对声音，强化战时体制。1944年，随着战局恶化，他被迫辞去首相职务，但仍然保持着对军部的影响力。这一时期，东条英机作为日本战争决策的核心人物，对日本在二战中的行动负有直接责任。
points.descriptionEn: In October 1941, Tojo became Prime Minister of Japan while continuing as Minister of War, concentrating both military and political power in his hands. He led the decision-making process that resulted in the Pearl Harbor attack, pushing Japan to declare war on the United States and Britain, escalating the Pacific War. Under his leadership, the Japanese military launched a series of operations across Asia and the Pacific, occupying large areas of Southeast Asia. Tojo implemented high-pressure rule, suppressing domestic opposition and strengthening the wartime system. In 1944, as the military situation deteriorated, he was forced to resign as Prime Minister but maintained his influence within the military. During this period, as the central figure in Japan's war decision-making, Tojo bore direct responsibility for Japan's actions during World War II.

points.title: 战败被捕
points.description: 1945年日本投降后，东条英机试图自杀未遂，随后被美军逮捕。作为甲级战犯，他在东京审判中接受审判。在审判过程中，东条英机否认战争罪行，声称自己只是在执行天皇的命令。然而，法庭认定他对日本发动的侵略战争负有主要责任。1948年11月12日，远东国际军事法庭判处东条英机绞刑。他的审判和处决标志着日本军国主义时代的终结，也成为了国际法追究战争责任的重要案例。
points.descriptionEn: After Japan's surrender in 1945, Tojo attempted suicide but failed, and was subsequently arrested by American forces. As a Class A war criminal, he faced trial at the Tokyo War Crimes Tribunal. During the trial, Tojo denied war crimes, claiming he was merely following the Emperor's orders. However, the court found him primarily responsible for Japan's aggressive wars. On November 12, 1948, the International Military Tribunal for the Far East sentenced Tojo to death by hanging. His trial and execution marked the end of Japan's militarist era and became an important case in international law for holding war criminals accountable.

points.title: 绞刑处决
points.description: 1948年12月23日，东条英机在东京巢鸭监狱被执行绞刑。他的处决是东京审判中最受关注的案件之一，标志着日本军国主义领导层的彻底覆灭。东条英机的死亡在日本国内引发了复杂反应，一些人视其为为国牺牲的悲剧英雄，而更多人则将其视为战争罪人。他的处决也成为了战后国际秩序重建的重要象征，表明战争罪行将受到严厉惩罚。东条英机的坟墓位于东京多摩灵园，至今仍有极右翼团体定期参拜，引发了日本国内关于历史记忆和战争责任的持续争议。
points.descriptionEn: On December 23, 1948, Tojo was executed by hanging at Sugamo Prison in Tokyo. His execution was one of the most closely watched cases of the Tokyo Tribunal, marking the complete downfall of Japan's militarist leadership. Tojo's death elicited complex reactions in Japan, with some viewing him as a tragic hero who sacrificed for his country, while most saw him as a war criminal. His execution also became an important symbol in the post-war international order, demonstrating that war crimes would be severely punished. Tojo's grave is located in Tama Cemetery in Tokyo, and it is still visited by far-right groups, sparking ongoing debates in Japan about historical memory and war responsibility.

supporter.zh: 在一些极右翼和民族主义团体中，东条英机被视为为国家利益而战的爱国者。他们认为东条英机在面临西方列强压迫时，为日本争取了生存空间和尊严。支持者强调他作为军事领导人的才能，以及在维护日本主权方面的坚定立场。他们还认为，东京审判存在政治偏见，东条英机只是作为国家决策的执行者，而非战争的主要责任人。这些观点主要反映了部分日本国内对历史的不同解读和民族主义情绪。
supporter.en: In some far-right and nationalist circles, Tojo is viewed as a patriot who fought for Japan's national interests. They argue that Tojo secured survival space and dignity for Japan when faced with Western powers. Supporters emphasize his abilities as a military leader and his firm stance in defending Japanese sovereignty. They also contend that the Tokyo Tribunal was politically biased and that Tojo was merely an executor of national decisions rather than primarily responsible for the war. These views mainly reflect different interpretations of history and nationalist sentiments within certain segments of Japanese society.

critic.zh: 国际主流历史学界普遍认为东条英机是二战期间日本军国主义的主要代表人物之一，对亚洲和太平洋地区的战争罪行负有直接责任。批评者指出，他作为日本首相期间，发动了侵略战争，导致数百万无辜平民和士兵死亡。他推行的军事扩张政策不仅给亚洲邻国带来巨大灾难，也给日本人民带来了毁灭性后果。东条英机在战后的否认态度和对战争责任的推卸，进一步加剧了人们对他的负面评价。他被普遍视为战争罪犯和日本军国主义侵略政策的象征。
critic.en: The mainstream international academic community generally regards Tojo as one of the principal representatives of Japanese militarism during World War II, directly responsible for war crimes in Asia and the Pacific. Critics point out that as Prime Minister, he launched aggressive wars resulting in the deaths of millions of innocent civilians and soldiers. His military expansion policies brought tremendous disaster not only to Asian neighbors but also catastrophic consequences to the Japanese people. Tojo's post-war denial of responsibility and attempts to shift blame further intensified negative perceptions of him. He is widely regarded as a war criminal and a symbol of Japanese militarist aggression.

objective.zh: 从客观历史视角看，东条英机代表了日本军国主义扩张时期的一个关键人物。他的政治生涯反映了20世纪上半叶日本国内政治军事化的过程，以及日本与西方列强之间的复杂关系。在流行文化中，东条英机常被描绘为二战轴心国的主要领导人之一，成为日本侵略战争的象征性人物。历史学界普遍认为，东条英机的案例展示了个人决策与历史结构性因素之间的复杂互动。他的经历也促使人们思考战争责任、历史记忆以及战后和解等更广泛的历史问题。
objective.en: From an objective historical perspective, Tojo represents a key figure in Japan's militarist expansion period. His political career reflects the process of Japan's political militarization in the early 20th century and the complex relationship between Japan and Western powers. In popular culture, Tojo is often depicted as one of the principal leaders of the Axis powers during WWII, becoming a symbolic figure of Japanese aggression. The academic community generally views Tojo's case as illustrating the complex interplay between individual decisions and structural historical factors. His experiences also prompt broader reflections on war responsibility, historical memory, and post-war reconciliation.

self.zh: 如果必须为天皇陛下而死，我将毫不犹豫地献出我的生命。
self.en: If I must die for the Emperor, I will not hesitate to give my life.

others.zh: 东条英机是日本历史上最黑暗篇章的主要责任人，他的名字将与战争罪行永远联系在一起。
others.en: Hideki Tojo was primarily responsible for one of the darkest chapters in Japanese history, and his name will be forever linked with war crimes.
